Describe a reference: which EINs, which names, which addresses

Source: R/md-spec.R
md_spec.Rd

A spec is the whole definition of a compiled reference (PLAN.md section 5). It is small, serialisable and hashed: two references with the same spec_hash were selected the same way. md_compile() turns it into the frame npmatch matches against.

Usage

md_spec(
  layers = "bmf_active",
  names = c("legal", "dba"),
  addresses = "mailing",
  sources = NULL,
  min_corroborators = 1L,
  max_names = NULL,
  max_addresses = NULL,
  drop_before_year = NULL,
  dba_as = c("column", "row"),
  label = NULL
)

Arguments

layers

Layers to include; see md_layers().

names

Name variant classes to include.

addresses

Address variant classes to include.

sources

Optional: only strings from these sources (bmf, efile990, f1023ez, schedi, schedr, meta_address). NULL takes every source. Since the e-file and 1023-EZ ingests, legal and mailing are no longer BMF-only, so a reference meant to reproduce a BMF frame needs sources = "bmf". Names are collapsed across sources, so a source filter cuts across the statistics cells, and those statistics are computed directly.

min_corroborators

Minimum distinct filers behind an observed name: 1, 2, 5 or 20.

max_names

Optional cap per class, as a named integer vector, e.g. c(observed = 3). Classes not named are uncapped. Capping per class, not overall, keeps a legal name from being displaced by aliases (section 7c).

max_addresses

Optional cap on first-party addresses per EIN.

drop_before_year

Optional: drop names and addresses last seen before this year. Rows with no year (most BMF rows) are kept.

dba_as

"column" puts each EIN's best DBA in the dba field of its legal-name rows, the shape npmatch's BMF reference has; further DBAs become rows. "row" makes every DBA its own row.

label

Optional name for the spec, e.g. "active-observed". Not part of the hash.

Value

An object of class md_spec.

The two selection axes

layers chooses which EINs can be matched (PLAN.md section 3). Every EIN has exactly one layer, so a union of layers is a clean union of EINs. names and addresses choose which strings those EINs carry, by variant class. An EIN in an active-BMF layer also has names from its own filings and from Schedule I; names decides which of those count.

in_care_of is not a selectable name class: it names someone other than the organisation (a person, an agent or a parent). Its organisational content is in the care_of_network clusters (md_build_clusters()).

Filters that keep statistics exact

Corpus statistics for a spec are sums over precomputed cells (layer x variant class x corroboration band; md_build_stats()). A filter that cuts across cells would break that, so min_corroborators - which applies to observed names only - must be a band edge: 1, 2, 5 or 20. max_names and drop_before_year do cut across cells; a spec using them is still compiled exactly, but its statistics are computed directly from the selected rows rather than summed from cells, and the report says so.
